newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gas Natural 9-mth net profit up 33 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gas Natural 9-mth net profit up 33 pct.

text.p: Results for Spanish energy group Gas Natural for the nine months to end-September, in billions of pesetas unless stated:
Investment in fixed assets 90.78 up 55 pct
NOTE: The firm said the improvement in results was due to costs containment and an increase in the number of clients.
The rise in operating profit was attributed to both investment and an expansion strategy, directed particularly towards distribution infrastructure and increasing the firm's services.
Assets totalled 760 billion pesetas at the end of the period, the firm said.
Natural gas sales totalled 83 billion therms, up 7.7 percent versus the year-earlier period.
In September the group started a reorganisation aimed at integrating activities and simplifying structure.
